snippet.title: Marble Champions Launch trailer
snippet.description:
Marble Champions is a fast-paced marble racer that combines precision racing with unpredictable chaos and creative freedom. The game blends physics-based control, competitive racing, and party-style chaos into one uniquely marble-powered experience

Marble Champions is now available on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715940

- Master fast, fluid marble movement across procedurally generated tracks
- Build and share your own tracks with the intuitive Track Designer
- Compete in the League, Daily Time Trials and Tournaments
- Race with friends in local multiplayer or run AI “Marble Shows” just for fun.
- Unlock a wide roster of marbles, each with unique stats and styles.
- Knockout marbles and play various mini games in the Battle Arena

#indiegame #racinggames #game #speedrun #gameplay #gaming
